claims.statement: The 2026-10-12 read-only egress audit found all Flannel and ztunnel instances Ready but no Gateway API CRDs/GatewayClass, NRI configuration, or kube-network-policies deployment; legacy Istio Gateway resources do not supply the Gateway API egress path. No egress enforcement is active. A capacity-isolated worker, declared Gateway API/NRI dataplane, private inventory audit, and positive/negative ambient canary evidence are prerequisites to activation.
